name: Maxcom S.A.
summary: Maxcom S.A. produces, distributes, and sells consumer electronics products in Poland and internationally. It offers phones, smartwatches, Mring, payment devices, gsm accessories, laptops, computer accessories, sound, smart home, sports accessories, car accessories, translators, and other products. Maxcom S.A. was founded in 2001 and is based in Tychy, Poland.
